conversion_contracts: Counter is sealed upstream; users cannot introduce new Counter implementations. Airbug supports explicit unit strings and u64 counts.

IntoCounter allows user wrappers to convert into one of the built-in counter types. Airbug accepts the converted numeric count as an attribute expression or work_units argument; trait-name compatibility is not required.
CountUInt, AsCountUInt and MaxCountUInt are crate-visible reexports, not public exported trait names. Primitive counts and nested reference expressions can be converted explicitly in Airbug.
BytesCount helpers count in-memory element sizes, not recursively allocated heap storage. Both of_iter helpers consume the iterator. CharsCount counts Unicode scalar values.
BytesCount::of_many takes usize upstream and u64 in Airbug. Both implementations use checked multiplication and panic on overflow.
limits: No compatibility aliases for concrete counter types or generated helper names
Complete option/report semantics and platform limitations remain tracked separately

contracts: Bytes helpers measure shallow in-memory layout; string/slice helpers dereference AsRef before measuring; character helpers count Unicode scalar values.
Iterator helpers consume owned items and their destruction occurs while counting, outside the measured operation when used in setup.
Fixed counters replace the same unit without discarding other units. Input counters supersede fixed counts of their unit.
Input counters are evaluated during input preparation on the sample worker. Airbug excludes pilot and warmup counts from measured totals.
u64 counts and u128 accumulated totals preserve exact integers before rate conversion.
native_differences: Divan exposes four sealed counter types; Airbug accepts explicit units including bytes, items, chars and cycles.
Divan mean_count divides the u128 sum by count using integer division. Airbug computes weighted rates from exact accumulated work and elapsed time without truncating the mean work count.
Airbug work_units leaves dynamic declarations authoritative; override_work_units explicitly replaces dynamic declarations across registered cases. API compatibility is not required.
semantic_audit.validation: Five focused counter tests passed on macOS; library/tests Clippy with all features passed. Related integration evidence comes from the preceding 68 attribute and 67 contract tests.
